assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, tenure, municipal utilities, demolition lists, and engineering constraints are not in the public site package and must be confirmed from official attachments before any statutory use.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, retain-renovate-demolish, and road alignments stay conceptual. Official-data arrival triggers full geometry and metric recalculation.

assumptions.statement: Submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA features are copied from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson. They are maintainer-defined rough polygons fitted to announcement verbal extents and announced areas, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas and ratios are low-confidence design-model values. They support intake and discussion only. Replace and recompute after official CAD/GIS arrives.

assumptions.statement: When an official or cleared SITE_BOUNDARY or KEY_AREA polygon is added to the repository, land_use, green_space, public_space, buildings, roads, phasing, metrics, figures, visual HTML, and PDFs must be regenerated together.
assumptions.impact: Do not patch a single layer in isolation after official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: No company list, investment amount, output value, fiscal commitment, or government event calendar is treated as a fact. Ecosystem cases are public international references, not local tenant commitments.
assumptions.impact: Industry and operations chapters remain conceptual suggestions for professional teams.

assumptions.statement: Any Agent proposal that touches safety, heritage, privacy, demolition, or public-space occupancy requires human confirmation before a spatial type is allowed to flip.
assumptions.impact: Civic-agent governance is a proposal-and-review loop, not automated enforcement.
